deviations: Centering tongues: full-height flexures (y 119.05..123.40, cut through the roof with U-slits) instead of 1.5-tall tongues floating mid-wall centred on y 119.4. A mid-wall horizontal cantilever is an 8 mm unsupported overhang when the cover prints roof-down. As built k = 2.92 N/mm (audit 0.75): 0.44 N at the 0.15 preload and 1.32 N at full float. Three pins give about 26 N/mm laterally, so they bend about 0.05 mm. Contact band y 119.05..121.60 covers the PCB edge both seated (118.61..120.21) and resting (118.40..120.00).

Tongue face set 0.45 behind the PCB edge with a 0.60 bump (0.15 preload), so the rigid tongue root never touches the PCB at full float (0.15 clear). The contract says "0.15 bump"; read here as the 0.15 preload. The tongue bottom is at 119.05, not 118.65, so the front tongue keeps 0.44 from the seated carrier flange (>= 0.40).

Rod-carrier pins: printed pins cannot exist on a part printed flanges-down, because they would point into the bed. The two datum pins are steel dowels, Ø1.5 x 4 (ISO 8734, a stocked length), set in 5-minute epoxy in Ø1.55 x 2.4 slip holes, so they sit flush with the PCB top (no stake heads, roof clearance 1.39). Rev A: was Ø1.5 x 3 pressed into Ø1.45 x 1.5 (review MINOR-5: 7 % hoop strain in a 0.675 wall). The hole floor over the cradle crown is 0.30 (declared). The 4 stake holes are adhesive points: epoxy through the Ø1.6 PCB holes onto the flanges, now at z 13.10 / 18.30, with 0.3 x 0.3 glue-dam rebates along both flange inner edges. Heat-staking is dropped.

C-cradle mouth faces -Y (away from the PCB), not +Y. The datum hole (-2.40, 16.00) sits directly above the rod end (x -3.0..-1.0), so the material above the rod must be solid to carry the dowel. Rev A (review MAJOR-1): the rod datums on the bore crown. Bore Ø4.15 centred at y 113.835, so the crown (115.91) puts the rod axis at 113.91, 2.00 below the LED faces. Below the equator each side is a curved lip flexure, 0.8 thick, rooted 56 deg above the equator behind a 0.4 slot, free 0.4 from both socket faces (1.4 long in x). Its hook (radius 1.84 about the rod axis, 4..12 deg below the equator) gives 0.16 interference and preloads the rod up onto the crown in any orientation. Snap-through 0.20 per lip (chord 3.60). The end walls widen to z 12.00..19.60 to make room (0.45 from the cover at full float).
Socket depth 2.2 (contract 2.0): 0.20 axial play per end for a hand-cut 66.0 rod, and the end wall behind the socket stays 1.0. Rod-end faces stay at x -3.0 / 63.0 nominal.

Contract-forced thin walls, declared: the C1 pilot (Ø1.8) inside the 0.4-tall P3 pad leaves 0.75 / 0.85 (C1 at z 2.35, P3 z 0.7..4.1). The C2 pilot (x 60.90) leaves 0.80 to the header-notch face, moved 59.3 -> 59.2 (J1 body keeps 0.43 at full float). The dowel hole (Ø1.55) at x -2.40 leaves 0.625 to the end-wall inner face and a 0.30 floor over the cradle crown. The cradle lips are 0.8, the outer strip beside each slot 0.525. The glue-dam rebates leave 0.7 of the 1.0 flange. The engraved-text ribs are cosmetic, in the top 0.4 of a 1.8 roof.
P3 pad z0 0.6 -> 0.7 and back-rail notch z -5.70 -> -5.80. The header body keeps 0.40 from the clip at full float (M-spec gave 0.30 / 0.32).

Left leaf b 6.0 (z -2.5..3.5) -> 5.0 (z -3.0..2.0), and the left corner-finger side part z 2.0 -> 2.5..4.2. The M-spec leaf and finger side part overlap at z 2.0..3.5 on the same x; they are now 0.5 apart. Leaf k 2.84 N/mm, 1.14 N at 0.40 (M-spec 3.4 / 1.4). Rev A MINOR-7 narrowed it again to b 3.8 (z -2.4..1.4) with the 1.4 -> 1.0 taper.

Roof underside 121.60 (1.8 roof). The tail pad is 0.20 proud at 121.40 (the stack datum) over x 52.9..59.0, z -5.6..0.5. Column bosses Ø5.2 run down to y 120.66 (0.45 above the seated PCB top) under the Ø4.4 x 1.0 counterbores. The contract columns are Ø3.6; rev A opens the bore 2.3 -> 2.5 (review MAJOR-3), so the wall is 0.55, declared thin (100 % infill, drill 2.4 through). Screws: ST2.2 x 6.5 pan, DIN 7981 form / PT-class plastics thread-former; head seat 122.40, tip 115.90 (0.30 above the case top), 2.5 engaged at C0/C1 and 2.4 at C2.

Cover walls sit 0.75 off the PCB edges (0.45 at full float), and the back-region walls are 2.0 thick so 1.0 remains behind the tongue slots. Skirt inner face at z 20.35 (contract >= 20.30), 2.0 thick. The front-region end walls sit at x -4.95 / 64.95. Rev A (review MAJOR-4): 3 grip ribs on each end face (x -6.25 / 66.25, z -6.5..1.5, centred over the posts, 0.5 proud, flat underside + 45-deg top flank) and a 0.6-deep fingernail ledge in the back wall (y 120.4..121.4, x 3..18 and 30..57). Envelope x -6.75..66.75, y 103.0..123.40, z -8.95..22.35 (M-spec -8.05..21.0).
Clip pilots Ø1.8 (rev A, was 1.6) are through holes. Blind holes would leave 0.4-0.8 floors under P1/P3, below the 1.0 minimum wall.

Corner fingers are 1.5 thick (M-spec 1.6; its printability table allows 1.5-1.6). Rev A: the back-finger and leaf bump crests are R0.3 rounds whose top keeps the 0.30 / 0.40 interference exact; the lip bottom inner edge is R0.5 (was a 0.3 chamfer); the back fingers and leaf taper 1.4 -> 1.0 with R1.5 root fillets, narrowed to b 7.6 / 3.8 so k stays at 8.7 / 2.8 N/mm; the back-rail outer face moves -8.05 -> -8.25 to meet the 1.4 finger roots. The tongue bumps get a 45-deg 0.50 lead-in (full crest from 119.55). The orientation arrow and "SCREEN" are engraved 0.4 deep, because the roof top is the print bed. The 0.2 elephant-foot chamfers are left to the slicer.
